name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) Fried Chicken Tender & Buttermilk Biscuit with Sausage Gravy
whyItWorks: Hearty mountain breakfast before heading up Logan Canyon! High protein, but rich with sausage gravy and fried chicken. Great stamina in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Chicken & Biscuit with two poached or scrambled eggs; ask for gravy on the side.
watchOuts: Sausage gravy and fried coating can be heavy during active gut inflammation
